mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, it is a clear night with a temperature of 58 degrees outside City Hall, and we are currently seeing a first quarter moon phase.

The city is currently managing significant infrastructure updates, including phase two of the Mark Drive reconstruction project and various pavement rehabilitation efforts scheduled for this summer to maintain safe roads.

It is a busy week for our community. Today, residents can attend the User Group Meeting at Epic Systems, take a yoga class at Insight Wellness, catch a performance at Concerts in the Park, or play trivia at Hop Haus Brewing. Looking ahead, we have live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market on Saturday.
In our weekly report, on August 15, officers responded to a call regarding a driver found passed out behind the wheel near North Main Street and Cross Country Road, which resulted in an O W I arrest.
Today's flavor is Chocolate Heath Crunch, but since the shop is currently closed, please note they open at 10 AM. If you are looking for tomorrow's treat, it will be Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie.
